$comment: pulley/registry/blocks/auth/manifest.json — created 2026-08-12 (T-11), rewired 2026-08-13 (T-10b): the auth core block. Better Auth (email+password plus ONE env-selected oauth provider) on Drizzle/Postgres. Every collidable surface is declared here so the resolver can refuse a bad install from manifests alone. T-10b closed the three gaps that made this block's wire-up a paste-in recipe: `endpoints` mounts Better Auth's catch-all route, `hooks` composes its handle into the app's hooks.server.ts, and the /sign-in route's `load` feeds the page the OAuth provider — which retired PUBLIC_AUTH_OAUTH_PROVIDER, a browser mirror of a server value that nothing could keep honest. `framework` records the kit floor this source actually needs; nav carries its own href, so route order is now just route order.
name: auth
description: Sessions, email+password sign-in, and one env-selected OAuth provider on Better Auth.

env.name: DATABASE_URL
env.description: Postgres connection string the auth tables live in.

env.name: BETTER_AUTH_SECRET
env.description: Signing key for session tokens and verification links. Rotating it invalidates every live session.

env.name: BETTER_AUTH_URL
env.description: Public base URL of this app (e.g. https://app.example.com). Defaults to http://localhost:5173 for local dev; set it in every deployed environment or OAuth callbacks break.

env.name: AUTH_OAUTH_PROVIDER
env.description: Which OAuth provider to enable: google, github, or microsoft. Unset = email+password only. The provider is chosen here, never hardcoded in block source.

env.name: AUTH_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID
env.description: OAuth client id for AUTH_OAUTH_PROVIDER. Required whenever AUTH_OAUTH_PROVIDER is set.

env.name: AUTH_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET
env.description: OAuth client secret for AUTH_OAUTH_PROVIDER. Required whenever AUTH_OAUTH_PROVIDER is set.
